text: Over the last 30 days, all visitor reviews for the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library have been positive, with an average rating of 5.0 and no critical feedback. However, comments related to food quality and wait times appeared in all three reviews, indicating these areas are frequently mentioned by visitors. Service was noted in two reviews, and atmosphere was mentioned once. While no issues were reported, the consistent focus on food and wait times suggests these aspects may warrant ongoing attention.

windows.60: Visitor feedback over the last 60 days indicates ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several reviews mention limited menu options, long wait times, and periods when full kitchen service was unavailable, leaving only grab-and-go items. Many found the food overpriced relative to portion size and quality, with specific complaints about certain dishes being unappetizing or poorly prepared. Service delays and unclear communication about kitchen status were also noted. While some visitors appreciated the library itself, the food and dining experience require attention.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service delays and long wait times were also noted, including times when the kitchen was unable to take orders for extended periods. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the café’s current offerings and operations are a frequent source of dissatisfaction. Addressing these food service concerns should be a priority.
